title: Boundary source depths on a fixed flat formal test
statement: Let S be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, c:C→S a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism, U an open of S, and PA a finite etale cover of C_U. Let s outside U be minimal under specialization among its complement and suppose depth O(S,s) ≥ 2. Set a:Spec O(S,s)→S, L=C×_S Spec O(S,s), and n:N_L→L to be the localization of the concrete relative normalization of PA→C. Assume n finite. For any d≥0 and flat t:T=Spec(O(S,s)[[X_1,...,X_d]])→L whose composite with L→Spec O(S,s) is the coefficient projection, and any finite indexing type G, set V=(t followed by L→C) inverse image of C_U. Both F=N_L×_L T with its projection r and E=∐_G T with its fold projection p have source stalk depth ≥ 2 at every point whose image in T lies outside V. This asserts only boundary depths, without a section or generic torsor hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply the boundary-dimension lemma to the original finite localized normalization. Use its normal-domain stalks and the normal local depth-two theorem to obtain depth at least two at its boundary points. For the fixed flat formal test, pullback.fst is flat. The pullback equation sends a boundary point on F to a boundary point on the normalization. The proved private helper depth_le_of_flat_stalk applies the flat local depth formula, transferring the depth bound to F.

The coefficient projection b from the finite-variable power-series spectrum is flat by constants_flat. Minimality of s, the pullback condition and the specified base equation show that every point outside V maps under b to the closed point of Spec O(S,s). Transport the base depth bound across stalkClosedPointIso using the flat local depth formula, and apply the flat-stalk depth helper to b. This proves depth at least two on the formal spectrum outside V, including d=0.

The coproduct fold p is flat, since each summand map is an identity; it is locally of finite type by source locality. Thus its source is locally Noetherian. Apply depth_le_of_flat_stalk to p and the formal-spectrum boundary bound from the previous step. Pair this coproduct bound with the F bound. An empty finite indexing type gives an empty coproduct, so this argument includes the empty and trivial-group cases.

lean.statement: theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_formal_boundary_depths {S C : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S] (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x)) (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] (G : Type (u + 1)) [Finite G] (U : S.Opens) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale) (s : S) (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s) (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := S.presheaf.stalk s) (S.presheaf.stalk s)) : letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U) (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι) let a := S.fromSpecStalk s let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a) IsFinite n → ∀ (d : ℕ) (t : Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (S.presheaf.stalk s))) ⟶ pullback c a), Flat t → t ≫ pullback.snd c a = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin d))) → let T := Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (S.presheaf.stalk s))) let F : Scheme.{u} := pullback n t let E : Scheme.{u} := ∐ (fun _ : G ↦ T) let V := (t ≫ pullback.fst c a) ⁻¹ᵁ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U) let r : F ⟶ T := pullback.snd n t let p : E ⟶ T := Sigma.desc (fun _ : G ↦ 𝟙 T) (∀ x : F, r x ∉ V → (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := F.presheaf.stalk x) (F.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧ (∀ x : E, p x ∉ V → (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk x) (E.presheaf.stalk x))
